column5: LADDER NOW MATCHES FIGMA EXACTLY - verified against the frames themselves, not against the spec: Easy Desktop 9432-8016 prints 1.03x..19.60x over 19 rungs and Medium In-Play 9428-8535 prints 1.15x 1.37x 1.64x 2.00x 2.46x 3.07x 3.91x 5.08x 6.77x 9.31x 13.30x 19.95x 31.92x 55.86x 111.72x 279.30x 1117.20x over 17, both reproduced by the rebuilt hypergeometric M_k = floor(9800*C(20,k)/C(20-H,k)) at a single 2% edge over 20 lanes / 1-3-5-7 hazards, board admin-tunable and frozen per round. ★ CORRECTION: the previous verdict said PARTIAL because CHICKEN_PLAYABLE=false - that is STALE. ChickenGame.tsx:162 is now `true` (enabled 2026-08-04). PARTIAL now for BUILD gaps, every one named. (1) ZERO of the seven vehicle sprites exist: taxi 9364-3821, sports car 9364-3823, hotdog 9368-3825, minivan 9368-3826, police car 9368-3827, truck 9368-3828, boxtruck 9368-3829. The in-play frame drives traffic through the un-crossed lanes; ChickenRoad.tsx renders none, and assets/games/chicken/ contains only chicken.png and roadblock.png. (2) flat chick 9380-10169 - the squashed-chicken bust art - is not built; ChickenRoad.tsx:182 draws a red circle with a text glyph instead. (3) The crossed-lane treatment is approximated: Figma puts the roadblock at the TOP of a crossed lane and recolours that lane's grate teal with a bolt mark, while the code keeps the grate at #001615 and only greys the payout chip. (4) The traffic light on the start kerb and the tree/foliage verges present in every desktop frame are not drawn. (5) There is NO /play/chicken route, so the 1440x3294 detail page 9363-1963 (mis-titled 'Hi-Lo Start') and the 375x812 page 9363-2936 (mis-titled 'Blackjack') are entirely unbuilt - Chicken is a modal off /originals, unlike dice/crash/mines/plinko/blackjack/coinflip/scratchers which all own pages. (6) Mobile ALT 9429-2661 has no mobile layout; ChickenRoad is one overflow-x-auto strip at every width. 0 of 21 frames have ever been visually verified. What IS right beyond the ladder: road #123f3c, grass #044629, sidewalk #a7a7a7, chip #b4c3c1, grate #001615, red finish gate, 247px board height, one lane per RUNG (19 easy / 17 medium) so no chip sits under a lane with no price, and only the next lane clickable so the rail's sequential-only rule is unrepresentable rather than validated away. Two live bugs fixed and covered by readChickenReveal.test.ts against the real engine (bust rendered as SAFE via a never-sent result.isBone; client-computed win drifting above the server's floored payout). Daredevil has no Figma frames.
